mapper.select: SELECT f.* FROM file f WHERE (f.biz_type IS NULL OR f.biz_type NOT IN (#{problemAttachment}, #{contestAttachment}, #{testData}) OR (f.biz_type IN (#{problemAttachment}, #{testData}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM problem p WHERE p.id = f.biz_id AND (#{scope.administrator} = TRUE OR (#{scope.problemManager} = TRUE AND p.author_id = #{scope.userId})))) OR (f.biz_type = #{contestAttachment} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contest c WHERE c.id = f.biz_id AND (#{scope.administrator} = TRUE OR (#{scope.contestManager} = TRUE AND c.creator_id = #{scope.userId}))))) AND ((#{scope.generalFiles} = TRUE AND (f.biz_type IS NULL OR f.biz_type != #{testData}) AND (#{scope.privateFiles} = TRUE OR f.is_public = #{publicAccess})) OR (#{scope.testData} = TRUE AND f.biz_type = #{testData})) AND f.file_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.fileName}, '%') AND f.biz_type = #{query.bizType} AND f.storage_profile = #{query.storageProfile} AND f.is_public = #{publicAccess} AND (f.biz_type IS NULL OR f.biz_type != #{testData}) AND (f.is_public IS NULL OR f.is_public != #{publicAccess} OR f.biz_type = #{testData}) ORDER BY f.id DESC
